message: Vector Rebel 3.2.63: retire Monthly Captain; add read-only Apparatus Check status for Truck/Medic tours and Station 4 C-shift Mondays.
releaseNotes: Removed the retired Captain Monthly action and Monthly Captain columns/requirement from Daily Captain Check. Added Apparatus Check: scans native Standard SCBA Inspection Item Logs for each assigned airpack and shows per-tour Truck 504 and Medic 504 completion, plus Station 4 SCBA Room on C-shift Mondays only. Green means native completed inspection exists for every current airpack; red means due and missing; ? means history cannot be fully verified; future blank; other station tours not applicable. It is read-only and respects 07:00 shift boundaries. SCBA airpacks default to Pass / Present / Working: one choice maps to all 11 verified native SCBA template 113271 questions. Missing marks all 11 checks as proposed Failed with a required comment only. Fail / Issue expands 11 individually editable checks, defaulting to proposed Pass, with a required comment. Specific answers are transferred into the official Vector form when fully reviewed, while unanswered checks are left for manual completion. Live Vector failure details modal was inspected on Voyager: choosing Failed opens a required Failure Notes field and an item selection. Rebel now fills that native field from the exception comment and chooses the exact failed SCBA item. The inspector reviews and submits the final native dialog. No inspection is auto-submitted.
